properties.project_name: Pier 54 -- shuttered/condemned pier and funded partial demolition
properties.digitized_from: No Assessor block/lot exists for this Port pier structure (confirmed: DataSF's 'Parcels - Active and Retired' Socrata dataset, acdm-wktn, has no PIER-numbered street_name entries). No Port GIS shapefile or site-plan figure was available, so this is a coarse locational box centered on the real DataSF street-centerline address range 500-599 Terry A. Francois Blvd (data/raw/official_street_centerlines.geojson), the address range covering the Pier 52/54 area (California State Parks Division of Boating and Waterways lists a combined 'Pier 54 & Pier 52 BLF' boat-launch facility on Terry A. Francois Blvd in this same stretch).
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- a coarse placeholder box, not a traced footprint, for the same reasons as data/manual/pier70_dry_docks.geojson (no parcel, no source figure). The box does not represent the real pier structure's true shape or its full extent into the Bay.
properties.why_no_real_parcel: Port pier structure; not on the Assessor's secured roll (data.sf.gov acdm-wktn has no PIER-numbered parcels near this site).
properties.regulatory_context: Condemned and red-tagged in 2024; the Port announced it would permanently close at the end of 2024, displacing the pier's tenant businesses (SFGate, Sept 2024). The Port's draft Five-Year Capital Improvement Program (FY2027-31, Feb 2026) budgets a 'Pier 54 Shed Demolition' line item totaling $2.0M ($500,000 in FY2026-27 and $1,500,000 in FY2027-28); no line item for full substructure removal appears in that document.
properties.notes: This is a Port maritime/pier facility, not an OCII Mission Bay South development block -- grouped under the Mission Bay South site here because that is the nearest tracked site and because DataSF's official 'Former San Francisco Redevelopment Agency Project Areas' boundary (data/raw/redevelopment_project_areas.geojson) for Mission Bay South extends north along the Terry A. Francois Blvd shoreline to include this stretch. It is materially farther from Mission Rock's own tracked footprint (Pier 48/50, ~470m away) than from Mission Bay South's nearest tracked features (the UCSF Illinois Street Garage/P24 lawn, ~30m away) -- see the PR body's geometry test for the full distance comparison. Recorded as adjacent rather than tracked because it is Port-jurisdiction maritime infrastructure being demolished, not a Mission Bay OCII development parcel like this site's other tracked records.
properties.digitization_method: 2026-09-28 -- CREATED as a coarse locational box (see accuracy_caveat and digitized_from), anchored to the real DataSF street-centerline address range for Terry A. Francois Blvd covering the Pier 52/54 boat-launch/pier area, then shifted east (further into the Bay, consistent with a pier projecting past the shoreline) so it does not overlap Bayfront Park's or 550 Terry A. Francois Blvd's real, already-tracked footprints (check_geometry_quality.py --strict). No owner review yet.
